review.assessment: This change creates solution.sh using a simple grep filter that only strips lines beginning with '#' at column zero. It completely ignores indented comments and blank lines, directly contradicting the task specification which requires removing any line where the first non-whitespace character is '#' or that contains only whitespace.

findings.defect: The grep pattern uses a strict line-start anchor (^#) that fails to match leading whitespace before the hash symbol.
The script lacks logic to filter out empty or whitespace-only lines, leaving them in the output unchanged.
